activation: When DATA_DIR contains paper.pdf and metadata.json, add these analysis categories.

paper_structure_analysis.title: Paper Structure Analysis
measure: Section proportions: what % of the paper is intro, related work, method, experiments, discussion?
Figure/table density: how many figures and tables per page? What fraction of pages have visuals?
Equation density: how many equations? Concentrated in one section or spread throughout?
Citation density: how many references? Self-citation rate? Recency of citations (median year)?
Abstract vs claims: does the abstract accurately reflect what the experiments show?

experimental_design_evaluation.title: Experimental Design Evaluation
per_experiment: Baselines: how many? State-of-the-art or straw-men? Fairly tuned?
Datasets: how many? Standard benchmarks or custom? Size and diversity?
Ablation completeness: which components are ablated? Obvious missing ablations?
Statistical rigor: error bars? Confidence intervals? Multiple runs? Significance tests?
Reproducibility signals: code released? Hyperparameters fully specified? Random seeds?

review_analysis.title: Review Analysis (if reviews.json exists)
quantify: Score distribution: mean, min, max, std of ratings and confidence.
Reviewer agreement: do reviewers agree on strengths/weaknesses, or diverge?
Concern taxonomy: classify each weakness into novelty, experimental gaps, writing/clarity, theoretical, scalability/practicality, ethical.
Fatal vs fixable: which concerns could be addressed in a revision? Which are fundamental?
Rebuttal effectiveness (if rebuttal exists): did authors address key concerns? Did scores change?
Meta-reviewer reasoning: what tipped the decision? Which reviewer's opinion dominated?

cross_paper_comparison.title: Cross-Paper Comparison (if multiple papers in DATA_DIR)
when_best_vs_rejected: Side-by-side metrics: table density, baseline count, dataset count, ablation count, citation count.
Writing quality signals: abstract length, claim specificity, caveat frequency.
What the winner did that the loser didn't: identify the discriminating factors.

index_additions: Tag paper-specific findings with additional types: structure / experimental-design / review-analysis / cross-paper.
